scope: Theorem 1.2 (Finite-dimensional fluctuation limit) of the manuscript “Hard-sphere fluctuations on the regular Boltzmann lifespan” (preprints/Hard-sphere-fluctuations-on-the-regular-Boltzmann-lifespan-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 364 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e294d8e5097f8d0e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under Assumption 1.1, the centered Gaussian generalized field ζ with weak equation dζt(ϕ) = ζt(Atϕ) dt + dWt(ϕ) (1.11) is well defined by its backward mild form on a scale of tests with small Gaussian growth. Its initial field is independent of W, and E[ζ0(ϕ)ζ0(ψ)] = ∫ R6 f0ϕψ dz, (1.12) E[Wt(ϕ)Ws(ψ)] = ∫ t∧s 0 Cr(ϕ, ψ) dr. (1.13) The Gaussian noise W has independent increments. For every integer m ≥ 1, fixed times t1, . . . , tm ∈ [0, T], and real tests ϕ1, . . . , ϕm ∈ C∞ c (R6), ( ζϵ t1 (ϕ1), . . . , ζϵ tm (ϕm) ) =⇒ ( ζt1 (ϕ1), . . . , ζtm (ϕm) ) (ϵ ↓ 0). (1.14)
